name: Michael Wakefield
text: Alex has done a great job on a few doors for us now where you couldn't even tell that there had been damage

name: Joe Holmes
text: Cannot speak highly enough of Alex from DentLab. His communication was outstanding, prompt, well priced and results are great. Highly recommend.

name: Donna Mulvey
text: Highly recommend! The level of skill, precision and attention to detail is second to none. He takes real pride in his work and has a real talent for making dents disappear, leaving an outstanding finish. If you want someone who knows their craft and takes the time to do the job properly, look no further. Definitely the person to go to for dent removal.

name: Alex Barclay
text: Alex at DentLab is an expert at his craft! So lucky to have found him to remove the dents in my car without needing to repaint it. Absolute professional - fast, affordable and just a nice guy. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Matt Kemp
text: Excellent service, really impressed with the final result. Great quality work, reliable and clearly takes pride in what he does. Would definitely recommend to anyone needing dent repairs!

name: Dave Mellis
text: Great job and very affordable, High stand of workmanship, highly recommend
